survey.what_is_it: service/pipeline — ecosystem memory infrastructure (stream ingest, analyst, distilled pool)

architecture_rung.earned_by: analyst phase (D3) uses fan-out read-only subagents; correctness stakes of a shared memory store warrant an independent verifier. No parallel writers, no seams that justify a fleet.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: sweep mechanics, hash ledger, append-only journal, dedup, eviction, staleness checks, provenance queries — all deterministic code. AI only: analyst pattern-mining (propose-only) and promotion judgment.

oracle_shape.goldens: strict pinned outputs for ledger ops and fixture-stream queries (deterministic by construction)
oracle_shape.ci: single-version smoke initially; matrix when consumers exist

consumes: autonomous (kit core, LIBRARY entry format, sweep primitive)

lifespan_autonomy.autonomy_tier: scheduled unattended sweeps OK from D1 (read-only + own-journal writes); analyst propose-only from D3; distilled-pool writes ALWAYS behind ratification until an ecosystem curator role is decided (see autonomous ROADMAP, ecosystem-lead milestone)
